args.summary: The latest deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in production. A rollback was attempted via the rollback endpoint but failed with transient 503 errors. We instead deployed v2.3.0 (the most recent release that was healthy in production) to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-deploy verification: service healthy, error rate 0.002. v2.3.1 needs investigation before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Investigated deploy history**: The latest deploy, `v2.3.1`, was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0`.
2. **Rollback attempt failed**: The rollback endpoint returned 503 errors on two attempts.
3. **Recovery via deploy**: Deployed `v2.3.0` directly to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — no change-manager approval needed since v2.3.0 has previously been healthy in production. Confirmed post-deploy: all regions running v2.3.0, service **healthy**, error rate 0.2%.
4. **Incident opened**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback attempts, and the successful redeploy to v2.3.0. On-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 should be investigated for the root cause before any attempt to redeploy it.
